decisions.rationale: Lead Stunfisk-Galar (Ground/Steel, Crunch hits Basculegion, resists Fairy) and Medicham (Mega Pure Power, Low Sweep). reflections.summary: Won because Whimsicott’s Taunt, Tailwind, and Encore controlled the opponent while Mega Ampharos supplied reliable special damage and Mudsdale cleanly answered Stunfisk. The preview plan was sound: Mega Ampharos fit better than preserving an unevolved option, and the four covered every revealed threat, though Basculegion was less central than the Whimsicott–Ampharos–Mudsdale core.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the same four and Mega Ampharos, but prioritize accurate Moonblast plus Dragon Pulse targeting over unnecessary Thunder risks. Preserve Mudsdale specifically for Stunfisk and keep Basculegion as a fast late-game option rather than exposing it early to Gyarados’s Intimidate.
reflections.notebook: Opponent Mega Evolves Medicham. Aegislash favors Attract/status play and is shut down by Prankster Taunt. Gyarados has Intimidate and revealed Lash Out. Stunfisk-Galar repeatedly selected Crunch and is exploitable with Encore; Mudsdale can absorb it, build Stamina, and threaten a super-effective High Horsepower. Tailwind lets Whimsicott and Mega Ampharos remove Medicham with Moonblast plus Dragon Pulse. Continue bringing Whimsicott, Mega Ampharos, Mudsdale, and Choice Scarf Basculegion; preserve Mudsdale for Stunfisk and favor accurate attacks when they secure a knockout.

reflections.summary: Lost because the preview was mismatched: Stunfisk-Galar is OHKO'd by Mudsdale High Horsepower and was locked by Whimsicott Prankster Encore into Crunch, dying turn 8; Mega Medicham was exposed to super-effective Moonblast and Dragon Pulse with no protection, fainting turn 6 before contributing; Gyarados and Aegislash fell quickly with no support value. Mega-evolving Medicham on entry wasted the stone against this opponent.
reflections.adjustment: Bench Stunfisk-Galar next game; do not Mega-evolve Medicham into open Whimsicott/Ampharos range—keep it base-form or behind protection until Whimsicott is gone; open with a focused partner to break Whimsicott's Focus Sash immediately rather than splitting Crunch damage.
reflections.notebook: Opponent core revealed: Whimsicott (Prankster, Focus Sash) uses Tailwind/Taunt/Encore/Moonblast and locks for 3 turns; Basculegion (Choice Scarf, Adaptability) in reserve with Flip Turn/Psychic Fangs/Last Respects; Ampharos-Mega (Mold Breaker) has Thunder/Dragon Pulse/Power Gem/Protect; Mudsdale (Stamina, Leftovers) runs High Horsepower/Rock Slide/Body Press/Protect, gains Def on physical hits and heals each turn. Not brought: Politoed (Drizzle, Sitrus) and Tsareena (Queenly Majesty, Wide Lens). Stunfisk-Galar must not be brought (Ground-weak, Encore bait, OHKO'd by High Horsepower). Mega Medicham needs cover from Moonblast/Dragon Pulse; avoid evolving into an exposed slot. Future plan: drop Stunfisk-Galar, protect/hold Medicham Mega, prioritize removing Whimsicott's Sash and stopping Tailwind/Encore before setting up.
